_comment: Cross-course standards overlap map for the Social Studies Hack suite. Each cluster lists the standards that cover the same topic across courses and the ALREADY-SOURCED primary sources to reuse (do not re-source). US.xx sources come from the geo provenance ledger + US content; GC.xx from the completed Government sourcing list. Verify W<->WH numbering before reusing World History items.
